mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, login_id AS loginId, password, user_name AS userName, nickname, role, lang_code AS langCode, use_yn AS useYn, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( login_id, password, user_name, nickname, role, lang_code, use_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{nickname}, #{role}, #{langCode}, 'Y', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, lang_code = #{langCode}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
